title: Two-room apartments in Ismoili Somoni: comparing offers

contentHtml:
Substantively checked and updated on 16 October 2026.

Ismoili Somoni in a listing identifies the district, not building quality or investment yield. Compare actual two-room apartments by area, condition and terms. The table is a limited sample of the agency’s own catalogue.

Method: published unsold apartments with positive price and area only; houses, commercial premises and land are excluded. Prices are seller offers, not completed transaction amounts. The median is the middle of sorted values, rounded to whole TJS. A small sample does not describe the whole market. Price and availability may change: open the listing and confirm current terms before deciding.

Compare the same offer contents

Ask whether furniture, appliances, storage or other spaces and rights mentioned in the advertisement are included. Request a list of items that remain. Different contents can explain part of a price difference, but photographs alone cannot establish their value.

Check the building and actual location

Assess access, shared areas, lifts and building services. Test your daily journey at the appropriate time. Proximity to the centre does not establish quiet surroundings, parking or constant rental demand. These conditions need separate checks.

Move from price to transaction terms

Confirm the current price, viewing availability and expected handover timing. Before any payment, agree its purpose and refund conditions. Discuss a suitable payment process and documents with the bank and relevant professional for the actual transaction, without assuming absolute protection.

faq.q: What do the table figures mean?
faq.a: They are asking prices from the agency’s own sample on the stated date, not every district offer or completed transaction prices. Check the listing for current terms.

faq.q: Does missing condition information mean new renovation?
faq.a: No. Ask the agent and check during the viewing. Missing information is not replaced with an assumption.
